// diagnostic E2723

Jet.GrammarTokenClash

This grammar has two tokens the lexer cannot tell apart

What

This grammar has two tokens the lexer cannot tell apart

Why

The lexer reads only the tokens the parser can take next, and where two of them match the same text it cannot tell which one the text is.

Fix

Make one of the tokens match less, or use them where only one of them can come next.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.GrammarTokenClash: Tests/UI/grammar_token_clash.stderr.

Error: Jet.GrammarTokenClash: The token rules `NAME` and `HEX` both match "a" where the parser can take either
  --> Tests/UI/grammar_token_clash.jet:8:5
    |
  8 |     HEX  : [0-9a-f]+ ;
    |     ^
 Why: The lexer reads only the tokens the parser can take next, and where two of them match the same text it cannot tell which one the text is
 Fix: Make one of them match less, or use them where only one of them can come next
